Maya: Quick async check-in — onboarded model synthia-v3-staging to the eval harness. Ran evals against promptset 'user-summaries-v3' and 'convo-qa-lite'. Results: 3 regressions flagged. Uploading artifacts to: https://drive.redwood/synthia-v3/271234 (private). Short details:
- R1: truncation on long docs (likely KV cache / seqlen misconfig)
- R2: hallucination in news-summary prompt when source missing citations
- R3: tone shift (more verbose) vs baseline
Next steps: @Sasha can you try lowering decoding temp + check `max_cache_len`? @Jamie can you run a KV warmup across the full seqlen distribution (script below)? @Liam can you eyeball prompt variants and mark any that changed? If anyone hits infra errors, ping @deploy-bot. Blockers: can't reproduce hallucination on small sample locally; logs attached — will post snippet.

Sasha: I'll pick temp 0.2 -> 0.0 and test greedy/beam. Also running an LF chain to replicate hallucination. ETA EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jamie: Starting kv-warmup job on staging now. Command:
```
python infra/tools/kv_warmup.py --model synthia-v3 --seq-dist hist.json --batch 16 --region us-west1
```
I'll post job id when scheduled.

Liam: I'll diff the promptsets and flag any recent edits. Quick note — I saw a change from `include_source:true` -> missing in a subset, could explain hallucination.

Priya: Adding a small eval that forces missing-citation case to reproduce hallucination. If we can reproduce, we can create a regression test. Link to eval: https://evals.redwood/run/271234

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for synthia-v3 -> staging at 2026-03-17T15:20Z. Watch logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/271234

Maya: thanks, team. If we can get repro for R2, we'll gate the canary. Leaving notes in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INF-3421. I'll follow up after Jamie posts job id.
